scene: Atop the tent roof, three exits await.
picture: Along the flat circus tent rooftop, a glowing night bus idles on the far left. The player, a tall Latino man in straw hat and red poncho with guitar, stands left of centre. A yellow bicycle rickshaw waits in the centre, while a suspended book cart lift hangs on the far right.
shown: A neon night bus idles at a rooftop ramp on the far left
A pedal-powered bicycle rickshaw sits waiting in the centre with its driver
A mechanical book cart lift hangs ready on a rail far right
